column2: 5. (1) The administration and management of the affairs of
the  Office  shall  be  vested  in  the  National  Hydrographic
Council (in this Act referred to as the “Council”).
(2) The Council shall, for the purpose of administering
and managing the affairs of the Office in a manner expedient
for the achievement of the objects of this Act, exercise, perform
and  discharge  the  powers,  duties  and  functions  conferred
on, assigned to, or imposed on the Office by this Act.
